Clean original-TV cartoon cel style, crisp black outlines, flat colors with one shadow tone, not painted. Exactly 8 SEPARATE full-body right-facing/three-quarter figures in a 4-column 2-row grid on truly transparent background. Each entire body, shell, flippers and toes visible, generous clear margins and gutters, no cropping. Row-major poses: 1 ultimate preparation lifting both long flippers sideways; 2 ultimate active fan stance with head visible and flippers extended diagonally in opposite directions, chest vents clear; 3 ultimate return/recovery; 4 neutral upright resting stance, flippers relaxed down; 5 guard curling flippers around front of shell; 6 upright hit recoil, not prone; 7 knocked out lying sideways, shell and head connected; 8 forward dash lean with long flippers swept backward. Desired native figure height 350-430px in 1536x1024 or higher. All animations will get separate code-generated wind effects.
